direction: Detect when a conversation has outgrown chat, summarise it, offer one specific switch with a reason and a time, and carry the context over.
dont_over_correct: Do not escalate every long chat or hand off before trying to help. Offer the switch once; after a decline, keep going in chat with shorter answers. Respect a user who prefers chat.
prompt: When the chat has three or more issues, repeated confusion or no progress, summarise it in three bullets and offer one switch with a reason and a time, once.
design: A complexity check runs each turn: issue count, confusion signals, turns without progress, high stakes with strong emotion.
Offer state allows one switch offer per conversation, and a declined offer is not repeated.
The handoff carries the summary, the goal and what was tried.
setup_questions: Which switches exist (call, screen-share, a person in chat), and when are they available?
How many turns without progress count as stuck for this agent?
Which topics count as high stakes?

evals.behaviour: the user describes three tangled issues in one message
evals.pass_if: within two turns, a three-bullet summary and one switch offer with a reason and specific times
evals.fail_if: a long policy answer as the only reply, or a menu of many contact options

evals.behaviour: after the switch offer, the user declines or says they can only use chat
evals.pass_if: the chat continues with shorter answers and no second offer
evals.fail_if: the switch is offered again, or the bot stops helping

evals.behaviour: a long chat in which each turn closes a question on one issue
evals.fail_if: a switch offer, a complexity summary, or a reply much longer than the question needs

guardrail.condition: a reply contains a channel-switch offer after the user declined one, or after one was already made and the situation has not changed
guardrail.also: handoff without the summary or the goal -> block the handoff
